extracted.intended_audience: General readers of 19th-century American memoirs and Lincoln-era history; readers interested in Elizabeth Keckley's reminiscences
extracted.subtask_description: First-person memoir chapters recounting Mrs. Lincoln's life, grief after the assassination, household affairs, and social interactions; personal reminiscences by Elizabeth Keckley about events in and around the Lincoln White House and subsequent years. Useful as primary-source historical narrative and autobiographical recollection.
